import duckdb, math
from math import erfc
con = duckdb.connect()
rows={}
for y in [2023,2024,2025]:
    cbd, rest, unloc, outarea, total, killed = con.sql(f'''
      select
        sum(case when latitude between 40.700 and 40.768 and longitude between -74.020 and -73.958
                 then number_of_pedestrians_injured else 0 end),
        sum(case when latitude between 40.50 and 40.95 and longitude between -74.30 and -73.65
                  and not (latitude between 40.700 and 40.768 and longitude between -74.020 and -73.958)
                 then number_of_pedestrians_injured else 0 end),
        sum(case when latitude is null then number_of_pedestrians_injured else 0 end),
        sum(case when latitude is not null and not (latitude between 40.50 and 40.95 and longitude between -74.30 and -73.65)
                 then number_of_pedestrians_injured else 0 end),
        sum(number_of_pedestrians_injured), sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed)
      from 'data/crashes.parquet' where year(crash_date)={y}
    ''').fetchone()
    rows[y]=dict(cbd=cbd, rest=rest, unloc=unloc, outarea=outarea, total=total, killed=killed)
    loc=cbd+rest
    icb=cbd+unloc*cbd/loc; irs=rest+unloc*rest/loc
    print(f"{y}: CBD {cbd} | rest(in NYC) {rest} | unlocated {unloc} | coords outside city {outarea} | raw total {total}")
    print(f"      located CBD share {100*cbd/loc:.2f}%   imputed CBD {icb:.0f} ({100*icb/(icb+irs):.2f}%)  imputed rest {irs:.0f}  imputed total {icb+irs:.0f}  killed {killed}")

a,b=rows[2024],rows[2025]
la=a['cbd']+a['rest']; lb=b['cbd']+b['rest']
p1=a['cbd']/la; p2=b['cbd']/lb; p=(a['cbd']+b['cbd'])/(la+lb)
se=math.sqrt(p*(1-p)*(1/la+1/lb)); z=(p1-p2)/se
print(f"\nCBD share: 2024 {100*p1:.2f}% vs 2025 {100*p2:.2f}%  z={z:.2f} p={erfc(abs(z)/math.sqrt(2)):.3f}")
z2=(9616-9134)/math.sqrt(9616+9134)
print(f"raw citywide 2024->2025: -5.0%, z={z2:.2f} p={erfc(abs(z2)/math.sqrt(2)):.4f}")
EOF
